text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, February 19, 2018 Posted by admin on February 20th, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Nike (NKE). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -163 points. 
Friday the Dow was up +19.01 (+0.08%) at 25,219.38. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.02%. 
There were 19 Dow stocks up Friday. 
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Pfizer (PFE) +1.54% and Wal-Mart (WMT) +1.50%. 
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) -2.31% and McDonald’s (MCD) -1.86%. 
Wal-Mart (WMT +1.50%) fell nearly 3% in premarket trading after it reported Q4 adjusted EPS of $1.33, below consensus of $1.37, and said it sees fiscal 2019 EPS of $4.75-$5.00, weaker than consensus of $5.13. 
Home Depot (HD +0.92%) gained +0.3% in premarket trading after it reported Q4 U.S. comparable sales increased +7.2%, better than expectations of +6.2%. 
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower. 
The national average price of gasoline is down dive-tenths of a cent at $2.525 per gallon.
